# Map icon attribution

The SVG files in this directory are by Caro Asercion, Delapouite, and Lorc and distributed by
[Game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net/) under the
[Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

The curated map library includes terrain, nature, settlement, route, landmark,
and creature symbols. Original icon names are preserved as filenames.
